 The Philadelphia 76ers will be without Joel Embiid when they host the Indiana Pacers on Sunday. Indiana, meanwhile, could also be missing several key contributors. Both teams are dealing with significant injury concerns heading into the matchup , which could have a major impact on their rotations and overall game plans.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement According to the NBA's official injury report, Embiid is out for right foot plantar fascia injury management. ESPN also reported that Philadelphia decided to hold him out of Sunday's contest. The Sixers will also miss Adem Bona (cervical spine sprain), Dominick Barlow (low back stress reaction), and Ariel Hukporti (right Achilles rupture).
 Indiana has ruled out Tyrese Haliburton (left hamstring strain), Johnny Furphy (right ACL surgery), and Ben Sheppard (left meniscus tear). Andrew Nembhard (left hip soreness and tightness) and Aaron Nesmith (left hand sprain) are questionable . T.J. McConnell (right hamstring strain), meanwhile, carries a probable designation.

 The Pacers could be particularly vulnerable in the backcourt. With Haliburton already unavailable, Nembhard's potential absence would leave more responsibility on Indiana's remaining guards. McConnell's probable status provides some encouragement, but the team will need additional playmaking and ball-handling to fill the gaps.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Philadelphia faces similar challenges in the frontcourt. Embiid's absence removes its primary interior presence , putting added pressure on the remaining big men to contribute on both ends. The Sixers also begin a back-to-back stretch Sunday before visiting the Brooklyn Nets on Monday.

However, the status of Andrew Nembhard and Aaron Nesmith could prove particularly important for Indiana, while Philadelphia must find ways to compensate for Joel Embiid 's absence. The latest injury updates will be worth monitoring ahead of tipoff.
